description: JAMESON v0.7 conformance cases. Every file under valid/ must validate. Every file under invalid/ breaks exactly one rule and must be rejected; `rule` is the spec section that rejects it.

cases.description: Answers only: no annotation carries `resolved`, at most one annotation per part, each one is the answer (§12.2).
Two labelers, a consensus answer, each labeler's box as its own region and a separate resolved region (§12.1, §12.2).
Track, frame, region with keyframe, nested segments, GLB meshes with an escaped node_path, nested spans (§6, §7, §14).
A part with opinions but no resolved: true annotation is unresolved, which is legal (§12.2 rule 3).
An answer may have empty values ('decided: nothing to record') when no field is required (§12.2 rule 4).
An answer whose origin is unknown carries resolved: true and no provenance (§12.3).
An opinion may omit required fields; `required` applies to answers only (§10.2, §12.2 rule 5).
Two opinions with no provenance on one part are legal: ids distinguish them (§12.2).
In a multi-opinion document an annotation without `resolved` is an opinion (§12.2 rule 2). Warns: producers SHOULD write it explicitly.
A region carrying only an opinion is someone's drawing, not part of the answer, and is legal (§12.2 rule 6).
A required field hidden by visible_when may be left unanswered (§10.2).
x- part type, field type, render hint, and format are all legal (§2, §7, §8.3.1, §8.5, §9.6). Warns: the x- format is not validated.
0.3 satisfies step 0.1 under decimal evaluation (§8.3.2).
With require_full_path: false a valid path prefix is a complete answer (§8.2).
Fields with empty files, parts, and annotations form an ontology document (§13).
Every top-level array is required, even when empty.
This folder's validator checks jameson_version "0.7" only.
part.file_id references no file.
values[].field_id references no field.
annotation.part_id references no part.
visible_when.field_name names no field.
Two parts share an id.
Two fields share a name.
Two options of one field share a value.
Part types must be registered or x- prefixed.
A row part's locator requires row_index.
file parts must omit locator.
At most one file part per file.
At most one frame part per (file_id, frame_index).
keyframe appears only on region parts.
Indices are zero-based non-negative integers.
A segment needs a complete start/end pair.
Every node_path element except the root carries [n].
parent_part_id must form a forest.
A child and its parent belong to the same file.
A child's node_path extends its parent's.
A child segment lies within its parent's time range.
A child span lies within its parent's character range.
track_id must reference a track part.
track parts do not carry track_id.
single_select values must be option values.
Numbers honor min.
Numbers honor step (12.505 is not a multiple of 0.01).
Text honors max_length.
A number field's value must be a number, not a string.
A field appears at most once per annotation.
bbox is exactly [x, y, width, height].
A cascading value must walk the taxonomy from the root.
With require_full_path: true the path must reach a leaf.
keypoints values use only rostered landmark names.
RLE counts must sum to height * width.
bbox3d has exactly one of rotation or quaternion.
A polygon has at least 3 points.
A text value honors its registered format.
Dates are ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD).
Geometry values appear only on region parts.
A region part has exactly one geometry-defining annotation.
Each drawing is its own region part: a second box on region 103 is not allowed.
A resolved region's geometry is carried by its resolved: true annotation.
An annotation carries at most one geometry value.
A resolved answer must answer every visible required field.
In a simple document every annotation is an answer and must satisfy required.
visible_when may only reference a field at a smaller index (§10.1).
At most one resolved: true annotation per part.
Without resolved flags a part carries at most one annotation.
from_annotation_ids references existing annotations.
from_annotation_ids never references the annotation itself.
A constraint set admitting no value is rejected at import.
min and exclusive_min must not both be present.
step must be > 0.
integer: true requires whole-number bounds and step.
max_length is not a legal constraint on a number field.
Backreferences are outside the linear-time safe pattern subset.
json_schema must be self-contained: no remote $ref.
max_items may not exceed the number of options.
integer: true with bounds that contain no whole number.
options are forbidden outside select types.
single_select requires options.
Options are objects, never bare strings.
cascading_select needs at least 2 levels.
Render hints are registered per type or x- prefixed.
Formats are registered or x- prefixed.
Field types are registered or x- prefixed.
is_true can only test a boolean trigger.
resolved is a boolean.
values is an array of {field_id, value}.
file_type is a lowercase extension without the dot.
Part source_id across files: two rows of one file carry different ids, and a row of a second file reuses one of them (§6).
Row source_id across sheets: two sheets of one workbook each have a row with id A-1 (§6).
Two rows of the same file share a source_id, as one sentence labeled at two words would (§6).
Two rows of the same sheet share a source_id (§6).
A part carries an empty source_id instead of omitting the key.
A part's source_id is a number, not a string.
